name: Serkle Opening Experience
play_policy: Cold launch / once per app session. Do not replay on every resume.

background.background_motion: Optional 1-2% slow drift only; never distract from the mark.

timeline.details: Background already visible. Full Serkle mark fades 0→1 and scales 0.92→1.00. No rotation.
Crossfade from full mark to left/right layers. Left moves -14dp, right +14dp. Plus fades 0→0.80 and scales 0.75→1.00.
Left/right return to zero offset with a tiny 2dp overshoot. Plus fades out during final 140ms. The mark must reconnect perfectly.
Very subtle warm highlight travels left→right across the mark or a low-opacity overlay passes behind it. Keep opacity ≤0.16.
Full logo rests completely still. No pulse.
If home is ready, crossfade splash opacity 1→0 while home fades in. Optional: logo scales 1→0.94. If app is not ready, hold the final frame until ready, then transition.

reduced_motion.behavior: Show static centered mark over the background, fade in 180ms, hold only until app ready, crossfade out 180ms. No split, plus, shimmer, or scale travel.

rules: Animate only transform and opacity where possible.
Do not decode large images every frame.
Use the native launch screen only as a static bridge; animate in an app-level splash component.
Never delay actual app readiness solely to complete decorative motion beyond max_animation_duration_ms.
